name: Admin Proposal Document Markdown
description: From the Documentos tab of a sent, viewed, negotiating, accepted, or rejected proposal, admin copies the Markdown for a generated development contract, formal commercial proposal, formal technical specification, or compatible attachment. PDF copy reconstructs extracted text with a warning; DOCX and XLSX copy and preview textual content and tables. PDF and image previews retain their original rendering, and every attachment can be downloaded as its original file.
